title: Pricing AI Features by Job-to-Be-Done
summary: AI features have unpredictable marginal costs, which makes pricing tricky. The right model depends more on perceived value than on cost accounting.
angle: Map AI feature types to pricing models: when per-use aligns with bursts of value, when seats fit habitual use, and when bundling removes adoption friction.
fitReason: It overlaps with the subjects and beliefs in your persona.
